label: Null blind
definition: Fixed deterministic row/hash buckets only; no predictions or task variables.

definition: Prediction-score bins x Unit Cost bins x Sales Channel subgroup; omits Order Quantity.

definition: Prediction-score bins only, with bin edges fixed from the baseline D_0 predictions.

definition: Prediction-score bins x Order Quantity bins x Sales Channel subgroup; omits Unit Cost.

definition: Prediction-score bins x Order Quantity bins x Unit Cost bins x Sales Channel subgroup.
